description_en: Queries the settings of Active Directory (AD) authentication on a bastion host
description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例上AD认证的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-instance-ad-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceADAuthServer

parameters.help_en:
